title: Funding Source and the Basis of Appointment Series Late-Cancellation Fees
content:
Revenue Cycle memo on how the funding of an Appointment Series sets the basis of its late-cancellation fee.

**Rule.** The late-cancellation basis follows the funding of the series:

1. where the series is funded by an Insured Plan of Care whose verified copay is above zero, the basis is the lesser of the late-cancellation fee of the series' format and that copay;
2. where the series is funded by a Self-Pay Visit Package whose package tier lists a single-visit cash rate above zero, the basis is 50 percent of that single-visit cash rate;
3. for any other series, the basis is the late-cancellation fee of the series' format.

**Records read.** The funding source on the series record; for a plan-funded series, the verified copay on the funding Insured Plan of Care; for a package-funded series, the single-visit cash rate listed for the tier of the funding Self-Pay Visit Package.

**Cases (hypothetical figures; format late-cancellation fee USD 35.00).**

| Funding of the series | Record figure | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Insured Plan of Care, verified copay USD 30.00 | copay below the format fee | USD 30.00, the lesser of the two |
| Insured Plan of Care, verified copay USD 60.00 | copay above the format fee | USD 35.00, the lesser of the two |
| Insured Plan of Care, verified copay USD 0.00 | copay not above zero | USD 35.00, the format fee |
| Self-Pay Visit Package, tier cash rate USD 125.00 | cash rate above zero | USD 62.50, 50 percent of the cash rate |
| Workers' Compensation Referral or Wellness Membership | — | USD 35.00, the format fee |
